title.zh: 感恩节后首个交易日：TSLA 涨 5.22% 收于 400 美元，SPCX 涨 4.83%；合并仍无协议与条款
title.en: First session after Thanksgiving: TSLA rises 5.22% to close at $400 and SPCX gains 4.83%; still no merger agreement or terms

summary.zh: 11 月 27 日（周五，美东 13:00 提前收盘）TSLA 收 400.00 美元（+19.86，+5.22%），区间 384.66–401.18，成交约 2,663 万股；SPCX 收 133.59 美元（+4.83%），重回 135 美元 IPO 价附近。24/7 Wall St.（Yahoo Finance 转载）把 TSLA 的上涨归因于合并预期，CNBC 把 SPCX 上涨归因于科技股反弹和马斯克扩大赠股计划。两家公司没有新的官方声明，换股比例仍未公布；涨幅是市场行情，不代表交易进展。
summary.en: On Friday 27 November (early close at 1pm New York), TSLA closed at $400.00 (+$19.86, +5.22%), range $384.66–$401.18, on about 26.6 million shares; SPCX closed at $133.59 (+4.83%), back near its $135 IPO price. 24/7 Wall St. (via Yahoo Finance) tied the TSLA move to merger speculation, while CNBC tied the SPCX gain to a tech rebound and Musk's expanded share gift. Neither company issued a new statement and no exchange ratio has been published; the move is market pricing, not deal progress.

items.source: Yahoo Finance (24/7 Wall St.); CNBC; Yahoo Finance quote history

title.zh: 马斯克补充赠股细节：SpaceX 那一股下月转出，他个人那一股等明年 6 月锁定期结束；之后每年再给每个美国孩子 1 股
title.en: Musk adds share-gift details: SpaceX's share transfers next month, his personal share after his lockup ends next June, and he will give every American child another share each year

summary.zh: 马斯克 11 月 26 日在 X 上称「美国每个孩子都会得到两股 SpaceX 股票，一股来自公司，一股来自我个人」，并说明公司那一股下月转出、他个人那一股在明年 6 月锁定期到期后转出；随后又称将每年再向美国所有孩子各捐 1 股 SpaceX。总股数与稀释规模仍未披露。与合并条款无直接关系，但涉及 SPCX 新增股份与马斯克持股，属于市场关注的稀释话题。
summary.en: On 26 November Musk posted on X that 'every child in America will receive two SpaceX shares, one from the company and one from me personally', adding that the company's share transfers next month and his personal share when his lockup expires next June; he later said he will donate another SpaceX share to all kids in America every year. Total share counts and dilution remain undisclosed. Not directly tied to merger terms, but it touches new SPCX issuance and Musk's stake, part of the market's dilution debate.

title.zh: SpaceX 宣布向每个活跃的 Trump Account 捐赠 1 股 A 类股，马斯克个人再配捐 1 股
title.en: SpaceX pledges one Class A share to every active Trump Account, with Musk personally matching

summary.zh: SpaceX 11 月 25 日声明：「我们相信，打造这些系统的公司的所有权应延伸到下一代美国人。」将向每个活跃的 Trump Account（530A 儿童账户）捐 1 股 A 类股，马斯克个人配捐 1 股。CNBC 称白宫 10 月公布约 7,000 万个账户已开设，但「活跃」账户数不明；SpaceX 未披露总股数。新发股份会带来小幅稀释，具体规模未公布。马斯克在 X 上转发了 SpaceX 公告和 Gavin Baker 的评论。与合并无直接关系，但发生在 SPCX 因合并稀释担忧承压的同一天。
summary.en: SpaceX said on 25 November: 'We believe ownership of the company creating these systems should extend to the next generation of Americans.' It will donate one Class A share to every active Trump Account (530A children's accounts), and Musk will personally match. CNBC notes the White House said in October about 70 million accounts had been created, but the number of 'active' accounts is unclear; SpaceX did not disclose the total share count. Newly issued shares imply some dilution, size undisclosed. Musk reposted the SpaceX announcement and Gavin Baker's comment. Not directly about the merger, but it came on the same day SPCX was under pressure from merger-dilution worries.

title.zh: FCC 批准 SpaceX「Starmind」轨道数据中心星座，最多 100 万颗卫星
title.en: FCC approves SpaceX's 'Starmind' orbital data-center constellation of up to 1 million satellites

summary.zh: FCC 太空局 11 月 25 日部分批准、部分暂缓（附条件）SpaceX 申请：最多 100 万颗卫星作为在轨数据中心，授权范围为备份/应急测控频段；须在 2033 年 11 月前开始部署，2035 年 11 月前完成 10%，2038 年前 50%，2040 年前全部。亚马逊、Viasat 与美国天文学会曾反对。马斯克回复 FCC 主席 Carr：「这将是美国和世界的重要资产。」这是 SpaceX AI 算力叙事的监管进展，与合并后「AI 基础设施」逻辑相关。
summary.en: On 25 November the FCC Space Bureau granted in part and deferred in part, with conditions, SpaceX's application for up to 1 million satellites operating as orbital data centers; the grant covers backup/emergency TT&C spectrum. Deployment must begin by November 2033, with 10% by November 2035, 50% by 2038 and the rest by 2040. Amazon, Viasat and the American Astronomical Society had opposed it. Musk replied to FCC Chairman Carr: 'This will be a great asset to America and the world.' It is regulatory progress for SpaceX's AI-compute story, which is part of the merger's 'AI infrastructure' logic.

title.zh: 欧盟把讨论特斯拉辅助驾驶（原 FSD）的 TCMV 会议从 12 月 1 日推迟到 12 月 15 日
title.en: EU moves the TCMV meeting on Tesla Assisted Driving (formerly FSD) from 1 December to 15 December

summary.zh: 欧盟委员会发言人向路透确认，原定 12 月 1 日的机动车技术委员会会议改到 12 月 15 日，未说明原因。此前两次会议讨论过特斯拉文件但未表决；欧盟范围批准需至少 15 个成员国、覆盖 65% 人口，欧盟层面否决会令已有的各国批准失效。雅虎财经把它列为周三 TSLA 下跌的原因之一。
summary.en: A European Commission spokesperson confirmed to Reuters that the Technical Committee on Motor Vehicles meeting set for 1 December moves to 15 December, without giving a reason. Tesla's file was discussed at two earlier meetings without a vote; EU-wide approval needs at least 15 member states with 65% of the population, and an EU-level rejection would invalidate existing national approvals. Yahoo Finance cited it as one reason for Wednesday's TSLA drop.

title.zh: 合并稀释担忧下 SPCX 盘中跌破 135 美元 IPO 价后收复，收涨 1.30% 至 127.44 美元；TSLA 收 380.14 美元（-1.18%）
title.en: On merger-dilution worries SPCX trades below its $135 IPO price intraday, then recovers to close +1.30% at $127.44; TSLA closes at $380.14 (-1.18%)

summary.zh: 周三科技股抛售（雅虎财经称纳指早盘一度跌 4%）中，SPCX 早盘跌约 8%（Benzinga 报 115.52 美元），TSLA 早盘跌近 6%。Gary Black 估算若 SpaceX 以 25% 溢价全股票收购特斯拉，需增发约 52% 股份，并称溢价可能被套利沽空「缩水到零」；Ross Gerber 也警告稀释。随后 FCC 批准 Starmind，SPCX 收于 127.44 美元（+1.30%，日内低 112.93），仍低于 135 美元 IPO 价；TSLA 收 380.14 美元（-1.18%，日内低 357.64）。公司未公布任何交易条款，上述溢价与稀释均为投资人测算。
summary.en: In Wednesday's tech sell-off (Yahoo Finance said the Nasdaq was down as much as 4% early), SPCX fell about 8% early (Benzinga: $115.52) and TSLA nearly 6%. Gary Black estimated that a 25%-premium all-stock SpaceX bid for Tesla would require issuing about 52% more shares and said the premium could 'shrivel to zero' as arbitrageurs short SPCX; Ross Gerber also warned of dilution. After the FCC Starmind approval, SPCX closed at $127.44 (+1.30%, day low $112.93), still below its $135 IPO price; TSLA closed at $380.14 (-1.18%, day low $357.64). No deal terms have been published; the premium and dilution figures are investor estimates.

title.zh: RBC 分析师 Ken Herbert：合并公告可能在 2027 年初，早于此前预期（分析师观点）
title.en: RBC analyst Ken Herbert: a merger announcement could come by early 2027, earlier than previously expected (analyst view)

summary.zh: 据 Bloomberg Law，RBC 的 Ken Herbert 11 月 24 日表示，特斯拉与 SpaceX 的交易可能在 2027 年初宣布，早于 RBC 原先预期；理由是近期关于合并委员会成员与财务顾问的报道显示谈判在推进，且 SpaceX 第三季度表现与展望让特斯拉股东更愿意接受合并。他认为对 TSLA 内在价值给予溢价或有道理，但投资者反馈显示 TSLA 持有人可能接受没有溢价的合并。这是分析师判断，不是公司确认。
summary.en: According to Bloomberg Law, RBC's Ken Herbert said on 24 November that a Tesla-SpaceX deal could be announced by early 2027, earlier than RBC first expected, citing reports of merger-committee appointments and adviser hiring as signs of progress, and SpaceX's strong Q3 and outlook making Tesla holders more receptive. He said a premium to TSLA's intrinsic value could be warranted, but investor feedback suggests TSLA holders might accept a combination without one. This is an analyst view, not a company confirmation.

title.zh: Seaport Global 首次覆盖 TSLA，目标价 475 美元，估值主要基于 Robotaxi
title.en: Seaport Global initiates TSLA with a $475 target, valuing it mainly on Robotaxi

summary.zh: 据 Investing.com 与 Benzinga，Seaport 预计 Robotaxi 到明年底年化经常性收入 30–40 亿美元，认为这是唯一能支撑估值的机会，同时认为汽车与能源业务被高估。报告未把 SpaceX 合并作为估值依据（就公开转述而言）。
summary.en: Per Investing.com and Benzinga, Seaport expects Robotaxi to reach $3–4 billion of annual recurring revenue by the end of next year and sees it as the only opportunity that justifies the valuation, while calling the auto and energy businesses overvalued. Public summaries do not cite the SpaceX merger as a basis for the target.

title.zh: FT：特斯拉与 SpaceX 公布谈判委员会成员与顾问，目标年底前达成协议但「尚未接近」
title.en: FT: Tesla and SpaceX negotiating committee members and advisers named; year-end target but deal 'not close'

summary.zh: 英国《金融时报》援引知情人士报道：特斯拉特别委员会由董事长 Robyn Denholm、Kathleen Wilson-Thompson、Jack Hartung 组成，顾问 Evercore；SpaceX 由 Roelof Botha、Randy Glein 代表，顾问摩根士丹利与高盛。交易拟为全股票，合并后约 3.5 万亿美元，双方正在建财务模型、谈换股比例，朝年底期限推进，但知情人士称尚未接近达成。马斯克依得州治理规则不正式参与谈判。特斯拉需召开特别股东会，须获全部已发行投票权过半数；交易可能面临美国、中国、欧洲和英国的监管审查。两家公司未就该报道发表声明。
summary.en: The Financial Times, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that Tesla's special committee is chair Robyn Denholm, Kathleen Wilson-Thompson and Jack Hartung, advised by Evercore, while SpaceX is represented by Roelof Botha and Randy Glein, advised by Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs. The deal is expected to be all-stock, creating a group worth about $3.5 trillion; advisers are building models and negotiating an exchange ratio, moving toward a year-end deadline, though people involved said an agreement is not close. Under Texas governance rules Musk is not formally part of the negotiations. Tesla would need an extraordinary shareholder meeting with approval from more than 50% of all outstanding votes, and the deal could face regulatory scrutiny in the US, China, Europe and the UK. Neither company commented on the report.

items.source: Financial Times via Investing.com; Reuters; Electrek

title.zh: 摩根大通：与特斯拉合并可能让 SpaceX 提前进入标普 500
title.en: J.P. Morgan: a Tesla merger could speed SpaceX's entry into the S&P 500

summary.zh: 据路透，摩根大通 11 月 24 日报告称，SpaceX 目前因上市不足 12 个月、GAAP 盈利条件不满足而不符合标普 500 纳入要求；若与特斯拉合并，按历史先例指数委员会可能豁免部分要求，触发约占自由流通股 10% 的被动买盘。标普已确认会随禁售期到期分阶段上调 SpaceX 的自由流通市值。
summary.en: Per Reuters, a J.P. Morgan note on 24 November said SpaceX is not currently eligible for the S&P 500 because it lacks 12 months of trading and the GAAP profitability requirements; if it merges with Tesla, precedent suggests the index committee could waive some requirements, triggering passive buying of roughly 10% of its free float. S&P has confirmed it will raise SpaceX's float-adjusted market cap in steps as lock-ups expire.

title.zh: SPCX 跌 5.65% 至 125.81 美元：纽时报道 SpaceX 靠出租算力补现金缺口；TSLA 收 384.68 美元（-0.20%）
title.en: SPCX falls 5.65% to $125.81 after NYT report on SpaceX leasing compute to cover cash burn; TSLA closes at $384.68 (-0.20%)

summary.zh: 据 Motley Fool 转述《纽约时报》报道：SpaceX 过去 12 个月营收 320 亿美元，但年烧现金近 400 亿美元，向 Anthropic（每月 31 亿美元）和 Alphabet（每月 8 亿美元）出租算力；马斯克内部抱怨公司正变成「算力出租公司」，并已削减部分 AI 项目、从 Optimus 抽调人手以加强 Grok。SPCX 周二收 125.81 美元（-5.65%），TSLA 收 384.68 美元（-0.20%）。马斯克在 X 上称纽时「把显而易见的事当新闻」。
summary.en: Per Motley Fool, relaying a New York Times report: SpaceX had $32 billion of trailing-12-month revenue but burns nearly $40 billion a year, and leases compute to Anthropic ($3.1 billion a month) and Alphabet ($800 million a month); Musk internally complained the company is becoming 'a computer rental company' and has cut some AI projects and shifted staff from Optimus to strengthen Grok. SPCX closed Tuesday at $125.81 (-5.65%) and TSLA at $384.68 (-0.20%). On X, Musk said the NYT was 'posting the obvious as news'.

items.source: The Motley Fool; The New York Times; Finabase

title.zh: TSLA 大涨 11.46% 收于 385.46 美元：FSD v15、合并预期与大盘反弹共振
title.en: TSLA jumps 11.46% to close at $385.46 on FSD v15, merger hopes and a market rebound

summary.zh: 美国周一（11月23日）TSLA 收盘 385.46 美元，较前收 345.82 美元上涨 39.64 美元（11.46%），盘中最高 393.83 美元。报道把上涨归因于三点：特斯拉周末开始推送 FSD v15；关于 SpaceX 可能收购特斯拉的讨论（汇丰把被收购情景估值定为每股 507 美元，Cathie Wood 称特斯拉股东会要求溢价）；以及英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职务后的大盘反弹（Investing.com 称纳指 +6.9%、标普 +5.0%）。没有新的合并公告或文件。同日 SPCX 收于 133.35 美元，较前收 127.79 美元上涨约 4.4%。
summary.en: On Monday 23 November TSLA closed at $385.46, up $39.64 (11.46%) from $345.82, with an intraday high of $393.83. Reports attributed the rise to three things: the weekend start of the FSD v15 rollout; talk of a possible SpaceX acquisition of Tesla (HSBC's takeover scenario values Tesla at $507 a share, and Cathie Wood said Tesla holders would demand a premium); and a broad rebound after Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO (Investing.com cited Nasdaq +6.9%, S&P 500 +5.0%). There was no new merger announcement or filing. SPCX closed at $133.35 the same day, up about 4.4% from $127.79.

items.source: The Motley Fool; Investing.com; MarketWatch; Yahoo Finance chart

title.zh: 弗吉尼亚州与俄勒冈州起诉 SpaceX、X 与 SpaceX Super Intelligence，指 Grok 生成深度伪造色情内容
title.en: Virginia and Oregon sue SpaceX, X and SpaceX Super Intelligence over Grok deepfake sexual imagery

summary.zh: 两州总检察长分别依据本州消费者保护法起诉 SpaceX Super Intelligence、X Corp. 和 Space Exploration Technologies Corp.，指控 Grok 可生成未经同意的性化图像与儿童性虐待内容，且公司对安全措施的宣传不实；寻求禁令、民事罚款、追缴所得等。俄勒冈州 11 月 22 日晚提交，弗吉尼亚州 11 月 23 日提交（CNBC 称截至周一早些时候仍待法院受理）。这与合并没有直接关系，但增加了 SpaceX（潜在收购方）的法律与政治风险。
summary.en: The two states' attorneys general each sued SpaceX Super Intelligence, X Corp. and Space Exploration Technologies Corp. under state consumer-protection laws, alleging Grok could generate non-consensual sexualized images and child sexual abuse material and that the companies misrepresented their safeguards; they seek injunctions, civil penalties and disgorgement. Oregon filed on the evening of 22 November and Virginia on 23 November (CNBC said the suits were pending court acceptance early Monday). Not directly about the merger, but it adds legal and political risk for SpaceX, the likely acquirer.

items.source: CNBC; Virginia Office of the Attorney General; Oregon DOJ

title.zh: 马斯克：特斯拉全车型内置 Starlink 希望明年年底前后推出，但中国除外
title.en: Musk: built-in Starlink for all Tesla models hopefully toward end of next year, except in China

summary.zh: 马斯克在 X 上回复称，特斯拉车内置 Starlink「希望在明年年底前后」推出，对无监督 FSD 很重要；随后又补充「中国除外，因为 Starlink 在那里是非法的」。这是两家公司业务纽带的表态，也从侧面说明特斯拉中国业务与 SpaceX 业务难以打通，正是合并的监管难点之一。不是合并公告。
summary.en: Musk replied on X that built-in Starlink in Teslas is 'hopefully available towards the end of next year' and important for unsupervised FSD, then added 'Except in China, as Starlink is illegal there.' It is a comment on business ties between the companies and highlights the separation between Tesla's China business and SpaceX, one of the regulatory hurdles to a merger. It is not a merger announcement.

title.zh: TSLA 收于 345.82 美元，单日跌 7.64%，同期纳指大幅回调
title.en: TSLA closed at $345.82, down 7.64% on the day, alongside a sharp Nasdaq selloff

summary.zh: 美国周五（11月20日）TSLA 收盘 345.82 美元，较前收 374.41 美元下跌 28.59 美元（7.64%）；当日开盘 370.43、最高 373.88、最低 344.33，成交量约 4451 万股。多家报道将跌幅主要归因于人工智能与成长股的大范围抛售（Anthropic 上市后的获利了结等），而非新的合并官方公告。同日 SPCX 收盘约 127.79 美元，跌 7.69%，市值约 1.74 万亿美元。美国市场此后进入周末，截至调研时（2026-11-22，亚洲/新加坡）尚无更新的正式收盘价。
summary.en: On Friday 20 November, TSLA closed at $345.82, down $28.59 (7.64%) from the previous close of $374.41. It opened at $370.43, traded as high as $373.88 and as low as $344.33, on volume of about 44.51 million shares. Several reports attributed the drop mainly to a broad selloff in AI and growth stocks (including repositioning after Anthropic's listing), not to a new official merger document. The same day SPCX closed near $127.79, down 7.69%, with a market value near $1.74 trillion. US markets then entered the weekend; as of this research (22 November 2026, Asia/Singapore) there was no newer official close.

items.source: Exa market data; StockAnalysis; Benzinga; CNBC

title.zh: 汇丰将 TSLA 评级上调至 Hold，目标价自 157 美元大幅上调至 359 美元，并把潜在 SpaceX 收购写入估值
title.en: HSBC upgrades TSLA to Hold and lifts its target from $157 to $359, writing a possible SpaceX bid into the valuation

summary.zh: 汇丰分析师 Michael Tyndall 将特斯拉由 Reduce 上调至 Hold，目标价从 157 美元调至 359 美元。新模型对两种情景等权：若 SpaceX 以特斯拉过去 30 日均价溢价 33% 收购，估值为每股 507 美元；若交易不成，按 DCF 的独立估值为每股 212 美元（此前 193 美元）。该目标价在发布时仍低于前一交易日收盘 374.41 美元。这是卖方研究意见，不是交易已敲定的证据。
summary.en: HSBC analyst Michael Tyndall upgraded Tesla from Reduce to Hold and moved the price target from $157 to $359. The new model equal-weights two outcomes: if SpaceX bought Tesla at a 33% premium to the 30-day average price, $507 a share; if the deal did not happen, a standalone DCF of $212 a share (previously $193). When it was published, that target was still below the prior session's close of $374.41. This is a sell-side opinion, not evidence that a transaction has been agreed.

title.zh: 候任众议院情报委员会主席 Himes 致信马斯克：不解释乌克兰 Starshield 断续问题，就难以继续支持 SpaceX 政府系统拨款
title.en: Incoming House Intelligence chair Himes writes to Musk: without answers on Ukraine Starshield disruptions, he can hardly keep backing funding for SpaceX-built government systems

summary.zh: 众议院情报委员会民主党首席议员 Jim Himes（预计 1 月出任主席）11 月 20 日致信马斯克，要求 SpaceX 高层解释 2026 年 10 月乌克兰 Starshield 服务中断的原因、是否由 SpaceX 单方面决定。信中称，这件事让美国政府与 SpaceX 的每一份合同都受到质疑，在得到满意答复前难以继续支持为 SpaceX 研制、政府拥有的系统授权拨款。Newsweek 报道称目前尚未实施任何拨款限制。这与合并没有直接关系，但 SpaceX 的美国国防合同本来就被视为合并的主要监管难点之一，国会层面的审查正在加码。
summary.en: Jim Himes, ranking Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee and expected to chair it from January, wrote to Musk on 20 November asking senior SpaceX officials to explain the October 2026 Starshield disruptions in Ukraine and whether SpaceX made the changes on its own. The letter says this calls into question every US government contract with SpaceX and that it is difficult for him to keep supporting authorization of funding for SpaceX-developed, government-owned systems until he gets satisfactory answers. Newsweek reported that no funding restrictions have been imposed. This is not merger news as such, but SpaceX's US defense contracts were already seen as one of the main regulatory hurdles for a deal, and congressional scrutiny is rising.

title.zh: 马斯克在《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会称特斯拉与 SpaceX「大概会更好在一起」，但合并本身不应触发其特斯拉薪酬
title.en: At the NYT DealBook Summit, Musk says Tesla and SpaceX would "probably" be better together, but a merger should not trigger his Tesla pay

summary.zh: 马斯克表示，五年前他看不到两家公司合并的理由；如今在人工智能、机器人和芯片设计上重叠增多，「你不需要它们在一起，但它们在一起会更好吗？大概会。」他强调必须经股东表决，且对自己在 SpaceX 的投票也须对其他股东负责。被问及合并是否应触发其特斯拉业绩导向薪酬时，他说不应仅因合并而获得奖励，应坚持协议原意。Yahoo/StockTwits 称当日 TSLA 涨约 1%、SPCX 涨约 1.3%。收盘价：TSLA 11月18日 383.72 美元，11月19日 374.41 美元。
summary.en: Musk said that five years ago he saw no reason to combine the companies, and that the overlap in artificial intelligence, robotics and chip design is now much larger. "You don't need them to be together, but would they be better together? Probably yes." He stressed that shareholders have to vote, and that his own SpaceX vote has to respect the other shareholders. Asked whether a merger should trigger his performance-based Tesla pay, he said he should not be rewarded merely for doing a merger, and that the original agreement should be honored. Yahoo Finance / StockTwits said TSLA rose about 1% and SPCX about 1.3% that day. Closes: TSLA $383.72 on 18 November and $374.41 on 19 November.

items.source: DealBook 2026 transcript (Singju Post / Elon Musk Archive); Yahoo Finance/StockTwits; Benzinga; CNBC

title.zh: CNBC：Kalshi 上「2027 年 3 月前合并」的概率从 27% 升到 62%；Jefferies 提示中期选举后审查风险上升
title.en: CNBC: Kalshi odds of a merger before March 2027 jump from 27% to 62%; Jefferies flags higher scrutiny after the midterms

summary.zh: CNBC 11 月 16 日报道，彭博 11 月 12 日传闻之后，Kalshi 多个合约的合并概率上升，其中「2027 年 3 月前合并」从 27% 升至 62%。这是预测市场的定价，不是公司确认。同文引述 Jefferies 分析师 Philippe Houchois：民主党赢得国会后交易面临更高审查风险，但合并后公司作为美国长期战略代理的逻辑仍然成立；彭博报道得州候任总检察长 Nathan Johnson（民主党）称交易将受到「巨大审查」。传记作者 Walter Isaacson 在 CNBC 上称他确信合并会发生，这只是个人判断。
summary.en: CNBC reported on 16 November that after Bloomberg's 12 November report, odds rose across several Kalshi markets; the 'merge before March 2027' contract climbed to 62% from 27%. That is prediction-market pricing, not company confirmation. The same story quoted Jefferies analyst Philippe Houchois saying a deal faces higher scrutiny risk after Democrats won Congress, though the case for a combined company as a proxy for long-term US strategy still holds; Bloomberg reported Texas Attorney General-elect Nathan Johnson, a Democrat, said a merger would face 'tremendous scrutiny'. Biographer Walter Isaacson told CNBC he is confident a merger is coming, which is his personal view.

title.zh: 彭博社援引知情人士称合并谈判有进展，最早或于 12 月宣布，也可能推迟到 2027 年初
title.en: Bloomberg, citing people familiar, says merger talks are progressing; an announcement could come as soon as December, or slip into early 2027

summary.zh: 彭博报道（路透等转述）称，SpaceX 与特斯拉的合并谈判正在推进，董事会与顾问正在敲定条款与合并后治理；知情人士称公告可能最早出现在 12 月，双方也讨论过推迟到 2027 年初的情形。报道还提到交易或为全股票、由 SpaceX 吸收特斯拉，换股比例尚未敲定，并需处理特斯拉中国业务与 SpaceX 美国防务合同的隔离问题。特斯拉与 SpaceX 当时未能立即置评。路透援引彭博称，截至前一收盘 SpaceX 市值约 1.90 万亿美元、特斯拉约 1.55 万亿美元。TSLA 当日收于 397.45 美元。这是匿名消息源报道，不是公司正式宣布成交。
summary.en: Bloomberg, as carried by Reuters and others, reported that SpaceX and Tesla merger talks were moving forward and that the boards and advisers were working through terms and post-merger governance. People familiar with the matter said an announcement could come as early as December, and that delaying into early 2027 had also been discussed. The reporting also said the deal might be all-stock, with SpaceX absorbing Tesla; the exchange ratio was not set, and Tesla's China operations would have to be walled off from SpaceX's US defense contracts. Tesla and SpaceX did not immediately comment. Reuters, citing Bloomberg, put SpaceX near $1.90 trillion and Tesla near $1.55 trillion as of the previous close. TSLA closed that day at $397.45. This is anonymously sourced reporting, not a company announcement that a deal is done.

items.source: Bloomberg (via Bloomberg Law / Bloomberg Línea); Reuters (via Investing.com, U.S. News)

title.zh: 特斯拉 Q3 财报电话会：马斯克称再谈合并像「在雷区踢踏舞」；盘后股价回落
title.en: Tesla Q3 call: Musk says discussing the merger further is like "tap-dancing through a minefield"; the stock fades after hours

summary.zh: 特斯拉公布 2026 年三季报后，马斯克表示对合并前景没有更多可补充的内容，并戏称自己像在「雷区踢踏舞」（tap-dancing through a minefield），同时称把合并说成必然是「言过其实」。多家报道指出，尽管调整后业绩与营收有所超出预期，投资者仍关注 GAAP 利润下滑、汽车业务走弱与资本开支指引，盘后 TSLA 约跌 3%。当日收盘 386.47 美元，次日收于 374.58 美元。
summary.en: After Tesla published 2026 third-quarter results, Musk said he had nothing further to add on the merger and joked that he felt he was "tap-dancing through a minefield," while also calling it an overstatement to treat a merger as inevitable. Several reports said that, although adjusted results and revenue were somewhat ahead of expectations, investors were still focused on weaker GAAP profit, the auto business and capital-spending guidance, and TSLA fell about 3% after hours. The stock closed at $386.47 that day and $374.58 the next day.

items.source: BBC; AP; CNBC; Yahoo Finance; Investing.com; Exa price series

title.zh: 摩根大通称中国监管或为合并最大障碍，并讨论「圈围」特斯拉中国业务的结构性方案
title.en: JPMorgan says Chinese approval may be the biggest obstacle, and discusses ring-fencing Tesla's China business

summary.zh: 分析师 Rajat Gupta 在马斯克确认成立特别委员会后发布研究报告，认为战略逻辑「仍然自洽」，但中国审批可能比特斯拉股东表决更难：中国约占特斯拉收入约 20%，且对 EBIT 与自由现金流贡献更高；SpaceX 深度绑定美国防务合同，Starlink 从未获准在中国运营。银行提出一种类似「镜像版 TikTok 安排」的设想：将特斯拉中国业务圈围或把控股权转让给中国财团，特斯拉通过品牌、FSD 等许可继续获得收入。这是卖方分析与假设性方案，并非公司已公布的交易结构。Gupta 还提到全股票交易、约 30%–35% 溢价、以及马斯克 2026 年 6 月行使 2018 年奖励后将特斯拉投票权提升至约 20%。
summary.en: Analyst Rajat Gupta, writing after Musk confirmed the special committees, said the strategic logic was "still coherent," but that Chinese approval could be harder than a Tesla shareholder vote: China is about 20% of Tesla revenue and contributes more of EBIT and free cash flow, while SpaceX is tied closely to US defense contracts and Starlink has never been licensed in China. The bank floated something like a "mirror-image TikTok arrangement": ring-fence Tesla's China business, or transfer control to a Chinese consortium, with Tesla still earning license fees for the brand, FSD and similar. That is a sell-side hypothesis, not a structure the company has published. Gupta also mentioned an all-stock deal, a premium of about 30% to 35%, and Musk raising his Tesla voting power to about 20% after exercising the 2018 award in June 2026.

items.source: JPMorgan note via Investing.com; Benzinga; Reuters analysis

title.zh: 马斯克在 SpaceX 三季报电话会上确认：两家公司已成立独立董事特别委员会探讨合并，但条款尚未达成、不保证会达成
title.en: On the SpaceX Q3 call, Musk confirms both companies have formed independent-director special committees to explore a merger; no terms are agreed, and none are guaranteed

summary.zh: 这是迄今最重要的公司侧确认。马斯克称自己是「利益冲突方」，不能参加委员会讨论，比喻为「一场奇怪的歌舞伎」。他支持合并（「你问我觉得这是不是好主意？是的」），理由包括超智能软件、芯片设计、Terafab、机器人、Starmind 星座的入轨运力与连接能力。他强调特斯拉侧需获得全部已发行股份（而非仅投票股份）至少 50% 同意，门槛「相当高」。BBC 称其评论后 SpaceX 盘后涨约 8%，特斯拉涨约 2%。WSJ、The Verge、路透、TechCrunch、AP 均报道。TSLA 当日收盘 373.71 美元。合并本身仍未宣布。
summary.en: This is the most important confirmation from the companies so far. Musk said he was a conflicted party and could not take part in the committee discussions, likening it to "a strange kabuki." He supports a merger ("You ask me if I think it's a good idea? Yes"), citing superintelligence software, chip design, Terafab, robotics, and the Starmind constellation's mass-to-orbit capacity and connectivity. He stressed that the Tesla side needs approval from at least 50% of all shares outstanding, not merely the shares that vote, and called that bar "pretty high." The BBC said SpaceX rose about 8% after hours on the comments and Tesla about 2%. The WSJ, The Verge, Reuters, TechCrunch and the AP all reported the remarks. TSLA's regular-session close that day was $373.71. The merger itself was still not announced.

items.source: SpaceX Q3 2026 earnings call, reported by BBC, WSJ, The Verge, Reuters, TechCrunch, AP

title.zh: 巴克莱称合并公告有可能出现在特斯拉 12 月股东大会之前，并认为更可能由 SpaceX 以换股收购特斯拉
title.en: Barclays says an announcement could come before Tesla's December shareholder meeting, and that a stock deal with SpaceX as buyer is more likely

summary.zh: 分析师 Dan Levy 将合并视为日益成为「共识预期」，一种情形是在特斯拉 2026 年年会前宣布（适用公司法下年会须在 12 月 6 日前召开；公司后续公布年会为 12 月 3 日）。他警告若在 10 月底或 11 月初宣布，可能反而增加在年会上通过的难度；若与年会分开，交易也可能在未来 6–12 个月宣布。巴克莱预计全股票、SpaceX 为收购方，并估算按当时约 2.1 万亿/1.5 万亿美元市值，马斯克在合并后或拥有约 37% 经济权益、约 56% 投票权。这是卖方推演，不是已公布方案。
summary.en: Analyst Dan Levy described a merger as increasingly a "consensus expectation." One path was an announcement before Tesla's 2026 annual meeting (under the applicable company law the meeting must be held by 6 December; the company later scheduled it for 3 December). He warned that an announcement in late October or early November could actually make passage at the meeting harder; if separated from the meeting, a deal might also be announced over the following 6 to 12 months. Barclays expected an all-stock transaction with SpaceX as the acquirer, and estimated that on market values then of about $2.1 trillion and $1.5 trillion, Musk could hold about 37% of the economics and about 56% of the vote afterwards. This is a sell-side scenario, not a published proposal.

title.zh: 摩根大通称 SpaceX–特斯拉合并在纸面上「战略自洽」，同时列出监管与治理障碍
title.en: JPMorgan calls a SpaceX–Tesla merger "strategically coherent" on paper, and lists regulatory and governance hurdles

summary.zh: 在 IPO 后市场传闻升温之际，Rajat Gupta 写道，合并可让马斯克统一愿景、使命与工程领导，人工智能是「战略胶水」。他指出两项可能的催化剂：SpaceX 上市提供高估值收购货币；马斯克将特斯拉投票权提升至约 20%。同时警告多司法管辖区监管（尤其特斯拉有大型制造业务的市场）、投票权不对称，以及市场可能认为这是 SpaceX 主导收购而非对等合并。当时摩根大通对 SPCX 为增持、对 TSLA 为中性。
summary.en: As market rumor picked up after the IPO, Rajat Gupta wrote that a merger could let Musk align vision, mission and engineering leadership, with artificial intelligence as the "strategic glue." He named two possible catalysts: a SpaceX listing that provided a highly valued acquisition currency, and Musk lifting his Tesla vote to about 20%. He also warned about regulation across multiple jurisdictions (especially markets where Tesla has large manufacturing), unequal voting power, and the chance the market would treat it as a SpaceX-led acquisition rather than a merger of equals. At the time JPMorgan was overweight SPCX and neutral on TSLA.

items.source: CNBC reporting a JPMorgan client note

title.zh: SpaceX 以代码 SPCX 在纳斯达克上市；COO Gwynne Shotwell 公开称合并「可能让马斯克的日子好过一点」
title.en: SpaceX lists on Nasdaq as SPCX; COO Gwynne Shotwell says a Tesla deal "might make Elon's life a little easier"

summary.zh: SpaceX 于 6 月 11 日公布 IPO 定价：5.55555555 亿股 A 类普通股、每股 135 美元，计划 6 月 12 日在 Nasdaq Global Select Market 与 Nasdaq Texas 以代码 SPCX 开盘。CNBC 等报道首日开盘约 150 美元、收盘约 160.95 美元，涨约 19%，估值超过 2 万亿美元，募资约 750 亿美元。同日 SpaceX 总裁兼 COO Shotwell 对 CNBC 表示，与特斯拉的交易「可能让埃隆的日子好过一点」，但强调公司当时专注现有业务、并非立即合并。IPO 与公开表态属已确认事实；合并仍未发生。
summary.en: On 11 June SpaceX announced IPO pricing: 555,555,555 Class A common shares at $135 each, to open on 12 June on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and Nasdaq Texas under the ticker SPCX. CNBC and others reported a first-day open near $150 and a close near $160.95, up about 19%, a valuation above $2 trillion, and about $75 billion raised. The same day, president and COO Gwynne Shotwell told CNBC that a transaction with Tesla "might make Elon's life a little easier," while stressing that the company was focused on the existing business and not on merging immediately. The IPO and the public comment are confirmed facts; a merger still had not happened.

title.zh: CNBC 援引知情人士：马斯克已与同事讨论将特斯拉与 SpaceX 合并
title.en: CNBC, citing people familiar: Musk has discussed combining Tesla and SpaceX with colleagues

summary.zh: 在 SpaceX IPO 临近时，CNBC 报道称马斯克已与同事讨论合并两家公司的可能性；报道还称特斯拉员工内部对此已有预期和讨论。这是匿名消息源的市场传闻，当时两家公司并未宣布成立特别委员会或达成条款。
summary.en: As the SpaceX IPO drew near, CNBC reported that Musk had discussed with colleagues the possibility of combining the two companies. The report also said people inside Tesla had already been anticipating and discussing it. This was market chatter from anonymous sources. At the time neither company had announced special committees or agreed any terms.

title.zh: 马斯克宣布 Terafab：由 SpaceX 与特斯拉联合推进的超大规模芯片项目
title.en: Musk announces Terafab, a very large chip project pursued jointly by SpaceX and Tesla

summary.zh: 马斯克在 X 发文称，将于当晚（美国中部时间约 20:00）正式宣布由 @SpaceX 与 @Tesla 联合开展的 TERAFAB 项目，目标是每年生产超过 1 太瓦的算力（逻辑、存储与封装），约 80% 用于太空、约 20% 用于地面。次日他又发文「SpaceXAI + Tesla TERAFAB Project」。该合作后来被马斯克和分析师反复引用，作为两家公司业务重叠、乃至探讨合并的背景，但它本身不是企业合并公告。
summary.en: Musk posted on X that the TERAFAB project, pursued jointly by @SpaceX and @Tesla, would be formally announced that evening at about 20:00 US Central time. The goal was to produce more than 1 terawatt of compute a year (logic, memory and packaging), with about 80% for space and about 20% for the ground. The next day he posted "SpaceXAI + Tesla TERAFAB Project." Musk and analysts later cited the collaboration often as background for how the two businesses overlap, and for why a merger was even being discussed, but the project itself was not a corporate-merger announcement.

title.zh: 马斯克回复 TED 的 Chris Anderson：原则上不反对把各公司并到一起，但怀疑有可行或合法路径
title.en: Musk replies to TED's Chris Anderson: not opposed in principle to putting the companies together, but doubtful there is a pragmatic or legal path

summary.zh: Anderson 发长文建议马斯克把特斯拉、SpaceX、xAI、X、Neuralink、Boring Company 等折入一个名为 FutureX 的单一实体。马斯克回复：「我原则上不反对这个想法，但不确定是否有务实或合法的办法把它们合并。把员工股权激励与各自公司的成就挂钩，也有其价值。」这是早期态度，与 2026 年他因 AI/机器人/芯片重叠而改口形成对照。当时并无交易。
summary.en: Anderson wrote a long post suggesting Musk fold Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, X, Neuralink, the Boring Company and others into one entity called FutureX. Musk replied: "I'm not opposed to the idea in principle, but I'm not sure there is a pragmatic or legal way to merge them. There is also value in equity incentives of people at the companies being tied to that company's accomplishments." That was an earlier position, contrasted with his 2026 comments once the overlap in AI, robotics and chips had grown. There was no transaction at the time.
